gloss: influential person; local boss; prominent figure

definitions.gloss: influential person; local boss; prominent figure
definitions.explanation: a person who holds power or influence in a community, organization, or industry, often through personal connections rather than official position

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔役|かおやく}だ。
examples.english: He's the big shot of this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔役|かおやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to pay my respects to the local bigwig.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔役|かおやく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{若|わか}い⟦{経営者|けいえいしゃ}→経営者：16188_keieisha⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談役|そうだんやく}→相談役：20958_soudanyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Known as a prominent figure in the industry, he also serves as an advisor to young business owners.

notes:
Combines ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face) and ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role). The word literally suggests someone whose face (identity, presence) carries weight. It can have positive connotations (respected community leader) or negative ones (local power broker, person with underworld connections), depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔役|かおやく}: local boss; community leader
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔役|かおやく}: industry heavyweight
- {顔役|かおやく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: known as a prominent figure
- {顔役|かおやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as a leading figure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ボス→ボス：11269_bosu⟧: boss — a loanword with similar meaning but more casual
- ⟦{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}→有力者：19082_yuuryokusha⟧: influential person — more formal and neutral, without the colorful connotation
- ⟦{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}→実力者：21845_jitsuryokusha⟧: person of real power — emphasizes actual capability and influence behind the scenes
